correctness.rationale: Exact transformation to two-dimensional orthogonal residual projections; iid signed directions induce independent Bernoulli switches and a binomial energy law. Gaussian transformed angles have known Poisson-kernel harmonics; a stationary ergodic log-factor strong law computes the typical exponent and a positive finite-dimensional transfer operator gives the mean exponent. Exact algebra and monotonicity settle angular phase boundaries; checked symbolic identities and the rational witness. Exceptional signed initial errors and zero-overlap case included.
